_description: Live-validated DNOS 26.2 corrections + per-recipe validated syntax. Append-only log. Keyed by recipe_id where possible so batch_discover.py can refresh entries in place.
_validated_on: PE-1, PE-4, RR-SA-2 (YOR fabric) DNOS 26.2.0; BGP EVPN RT-2 commands revalidated on YOR_PE-1 / PE-1 100.64.2.33

evpn_si_layer_verification_commands._description: Validated 2026-04-29 during AC<->EVPN MAC mobility test on EVPN_SI_VPLS_1, MAC 00:10:94:00:00:01. These are the canonical layer-1..4 verifiers for EVPN-SI MAC mobility tests.
L1_per_mac_detail: show evpn mac-table detail instance <name> mac <mac>
L3_bgp_advertise: show bgp l2vpn evpn summary | no-more
show bgp l2vpn vpls summary | no-more
L4_forwarding: show evpn forwarding-table mac-address-table instance <name> mac <mac>

expected_protocol_field.Local: PE owns the MAC locally on AC -- has full Mobility History
expected_protocol_field.bgp: PE learned MAC via EVPN RT-2 from remote PE -- only latest seq, no history
expected_protocol_field.VPLS_PW: PE learned MAC via VPLS PW from remote PE -- never tracks mobility

evpn_si_layer_verification_commands.mobility_history_asymmetry_rule: Mobility History is ONLY tracked on the PE that currently owns the MAC LOCALLY. On Local->bgp/VPLS_PW transition, history is FLUSHED. Remote PEs show only latest seq from RT-2.

command_corrections.wrong: show evpn mac-table detail mac <mac>  on  PE  in  bgp/PW state expecting mobility history
command_corrections.correct: Only Local-owner PE keeps mobility history. To see moves: query the CURRENT Local owner.
command_corrections.reason: Live-validated 2026-04-29: PE-1 with Protocol bgp showed Sequence number 5 but EMPTY Mobility History because history is flushed on Local->bgp transition. PE-4 with Protocol Local showed full 6-event history.

command_corrections.wrong: show evpn instance <name> detail | include Mobility
command_corrections.correct: show evpn instance <name> detail   # then read Mobility threshold + window from output
command_corrections.reason: Mobility config (threshold, detection window) is in instance detail, not a separate sub-command.

command_corrections.wrong: show bgp l2vpn evpn route mac-address
command_corrections.correct: show bgp l2vpn evpn route-type 2 | include <mac>
command_corrections.reason: DNOS does not support 'route mac-address' subcommand. Live PE-1 validation 2026-04-30 showed route-type 2 is valid and filters Type-2 MAC routes.

command_corrections.correct: show bgp l2vpn evpn route-type 2 | include <mac>
command_corrections.reason: Live PE-1 validation 2026-04-30 rejected 'mac-address' with ERROR: Unknown word. The completion token is 'mac', not 'mac-address'.

command_corrections.wrong: using only show bgp l2vpn evpn mac <mac> to prove RT-2 advertisement
command_corrections.correct: For local-owner proof use show bgp l2vpn evpn neighbors <rr-peer> advertised-routes | include <mac>; for remote-owner proof use received-routes/routes | include <mac>; collect route-type 2 as fallback context.
command_corrections.reason: Live PE-1 validation 2026-04-30 showed 'mac' is a valid token, but empty output is not sufficient proof of absence unless peer advertised/received route evidence is also collected.
dnos-internal mac-mobility-redis-count may not exist; live PE-1 validation on 2026-04-30 showed 'show evpn mac summary' is valid while 'show evpn mac-table summary' is invalid.
Live PE-1 validation on 2026-04-30 rejected 'show evpn mac-table summary' with ERROR: Unknown word 'summary'.
Live PE-1 validation on 2026-04-30 showed bare show bridge-domain instance is incomplete; use summary for global BD status, or instance <bd-name>/all for scoped detail.

command_corrections.wrong: show dnos-internal routing evpn instance <X> mac-table-ghost | no-more
command_corrections.correct: show dnos-internal routing evpn instance <X> mac-table-ghost detail | no-more
command_corrections.reason: Bulk-fixed across ac_ac, ac_evpn, ac_pw, aging_timers, evpn_pw, ha_mac_mobility, irb_si_rejection, pw_pw, sticky_modes, withdraw_flush recipes on 2026-04-30. Live PE-1 rejects the bare form with ERROR: Incomplete command; the `detail` suffix is mandatory.

command_corrections.wrong: show dnos-internal routing evpn mac-mobility-redis-count | no-more
command_corrections.reason: Bulk-fixed across ac_ac, clear_operations, evpn_evpn, ha_mac_mobility, pw_suppression_sanctions, scale_64k recipes on 2026-04-30. Live PE-1 has no mac-mobility-redis-count operational command; per-EVI MAC counts come from `show evpn mac summary`.
DNOS 26.2 IRB syntax: top-level 'interfaces irbN' (no dash, no space, no nested 'irb interface' keyword). Live-validated PE-1 2026-04-19.

command_corrections.wrong: network-services evpn instance X bridge-domain default-bd irb interface irb-9099
command_corrections.correct: network-services evpn instance X router-interface irb9099
command_corrections.reason: DNOS 26.2 binds IRB to EVPN via 'router-interface <if>' directly under instance. There is NO 'bridge-domain default-bd irb interface' nested keyword. Live-validated PE-1 2026-04-19.

command_corrections.wrong: show evpn mac-table instance X detail
command_corrections.correct: show evpn mac-table detail instance X
command_corrections.reason: DNOS 26.2 requires 'detail' keyword BEFORE 'instance <name>'. Flagged in test-live-device-validation rule.
DNOS 26.2 clear command order: 'instance <name>' comes BEFORE 'mac-suppression'. Live-validated PE-1 2026-04-21.
DNOS 26.2 clear command order. Live-validated PE-1 2026-04-21.

command_corrections.wrong: show dnos-internal routing evpn instance X mac-table-ghost | no-more
command_corrections.correct: show dnos-internal routing evpn instance X mac-table-ghost detail | no-more
command_corrections.reason: DNOS 26.2 returns 'ERROR: Incomplete command.' without the 'detail' keyword (or a MAC). 'detail' is the correct suffix for batch collection. Live-validated PE-1 (DNOS 26.2.0 build 20_priv) by tools/batch_discover.py on 2026-04-20.

command_corrections.wrong: show system npu-resources ncp X mac | no-more
command_corrections.correct: show system npu-resources ncp X | no-more
command_corrections.reason: DNOS 26.2 rejects 'mac' suffix with 'ERROR: Unknown word: mac'. Base command already emits shared-buffer and SRAM counters -- no additional keyword needed. Live-validated PE-1 on 2026-04-20 via batch_discover.py.

command_corrections.wrong: show config network-services evpn instance X bridge-domain | no-more
command_corrections.correct: show config network-services evpn instance X | no-more
command_corrections.reason: DNOS 26.2 rejects 'bridge-domain' suffix -- there is no nested bridge-domain subtree under evpn instance show config. The instance show already emits all children. Live-validated PE-1 on 2026-04-20 via batch_discover.py.

global_irb_interface.naming: irbN where N is integer; no dash, no space

evpn_irb_binding.example: network-services evpn instance test_irb_reject router-interface irb9099
evpn_irb_binding.rejection_message: ERROR: EVPN router-interface (IRB) and Seamless VPLS (EVPN seamless-integration) cannot be configured at the same time.

dnos_26_2_irb_evpn_syntax.discovery_method: interactive ? completion under 'network-services evpn instance HA_TEST_ELAN ?' revealed 'router-interface' keyword. 'irb interface' keyword does NOT exist in DNOS 26.2 (Confluence sample referenced legacy DNOS 25.x syntax).

dnos_26_2_loop_prevention_action.config_path: network-services evpn instance <name> mac-handling loop-prevention action <value>
dnos_26_2_loop_prevention_action.discovery_method: ? completion under 'mac-handling loop-prevention action ?' on PE-1 DNOS 26.2 showed only suppress/blackhole/shutdown.
dnos_26_2_loop_prevention_action.notes: 'drop' and 'freeze' are Confluence-documented but DO NOT exist in DNOS 26.2 CLI. pw_suppression_sanctions G4 recipe must use 'blackhole' where Confluence says 'drop'.

dnos_26_2_clear_commands.rule: All 'clear evpn' sub-commands with per-instance scope put the 'instance <name>' token AFTER 'evpn' and BEFORE the action keyword.
dnos_26_2_clear_commands.exception: 'clear evpn mac-table instance <name>' -- mac-table comes BEFORE instance (this is the documented odd-one-out).

irb_si_rejection.rejection_error_captured: ERROR: EVPN router-interface (IRB) and Seamless VPLS (EVPN seamless-integration) cannot be configured at the same time. .
irb_si_rejection.notes: SC01 live PASS. SC02/SC03 expected to PASS because they use the same stateful SSH + commit_check_assert flow as SC01.

clear_operations.trigger_handler: clear_assert_state (new in Block 3) + existing clear_command fallback
clear_operations.notes: Clear command forms validated via 'clear evpn instance HA_TEST_ELAN ?' ? completion. 'mac-suppression', 'mac-history', 'restore-cycles' all exist. setup_trigger 'rapid_flap_to_create_suppression' is optional -- if no suppressed MACs present, SC01 still validates 'clear suppression' returns success without error.

evpn_evpn.trigger_handler: spirent_evpn_seq_race (new in Block 3, delegates to spirent_tool evpn-routes with --seq + --label)
evpn_evpn.notes: spirent_tool.py already supports --count, --seq, --next-hop. SC01 uses two sequential evpn-routes calls with different --seq and --next-hop to simulate PE-A vs PE-B.

scale_64k.trigger_handler: spirent_bulk_learn_assert (new in Block 3, delegates to spirent_tool evpn-routes --count for RT-2 bulk OR create-stream for AC bulk)
scale_64k.notes: 64K via evpn-routes --count 65536 --mac 00:10:00:00:00:01 is the most reliable bulk path because it bypasses AC traffic rate limits. AC-based bulk learn would need MAC modifier on create-stream (not currently wired). First approach used.

pw_suppression_sanctions.trigger_handler: cross_domain_sanction_assert (new in Block 3, combines config-change + rapid AC<->EVPN flap)
pw_suppression_sanctions.sanction_value_correction: 'drop' in meeting notes -> 'blackhole' in DNOS 26.2 CLI. See dnos_26_2_loop_prevention_action above.
pw_suppression_sanctions.notes: Handler does: (1) set loop-prevention action to scenario's sanction value, (2) alternating L2 + RT-2 inject, (3) verify sanction state. Always restores action=suppress in cleanup.
